Calculate a credit-weighted GPA from your course grade points.

CreditsGrade points

Local processing · No account needed
THE QUICK HOW-TO

Small task. Sorted.

Enter each course’s credit hours and grade points on your institution’s scale. GPA is the sum of credits multiplied by grade points divided by total credits. This tool accepts a maximum scale between 1 and 10.

Try this example

A 3-credit course at 4.0 and a 2-credit course at 3.0 give a GPA of 3.60.

Good to know

Can I use this for my CGPA?

Yes, if you enter all included courses on a consistent scale. Retakes, exclusions and institutional rounding policies must be applied separately.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
